item.title: DUI-Related Three-Vehicle Crash in Cass Township Leaves Multiple Injured; Driver Charged
item.description: A DUI-related, three-vehicle crash on Sunbury Road in Cass Township left multiple people injured earlier this month, and criminal charges have now been filed against one of the drivers, according to Pennsylvania State Police – Frackville. The crash occurred at approximately 12:50 p.m. on December 16, 2025, in the 700 block of Sunbury Road (State Route 901). item.title: Emergency Personnel Responding to Working House Fire in West Brunswick Township
item.description: Emergency personnel are at the scene of a working house fire in West Brunswick Township.Around 4:30pm Friday, firefighters were called to 202 Sculps Hill Road, in West Brunswick Township for a report of a house fire with one person unaccounted for.The first units to arrived advised of a working fire and a tanker task force was requested.UPDATE: (4:49pm) - All emergency personnel operating inside have been told to evacuate the structureMore details as information becomes available.

item.title: Three Schuylkill League Athletes Selected for 2025 Mini Max Football Honors
item.description: Three Schuylkill League football players were among those recognized statewide on Wednesday as part of a prestigious academic and athletic honor. Minersville Area’s Dante Carr, Panther Valley’s Brody Breiner, and Tri-Valley’s Cole Gemberling were named 2025 Pennsylvania Mini Max Award winners, as announced by Maxwell Football Club President Mark Dianno.
